root_cause.text: The signed comparison in `io_poll_get_ownership()` treats the `poll_refs` atomic value as a signed integer, so when the high bit (IO_POLL_CANCEL_FLAG, BIT(31)) is set, the value becomes negative and the `>= IO_POLL_REF_BIAS` check always fails, preventing the slowpath from handling cancellation.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and patch diff show the change from `atomic_read(&req->poll_refs) >= IO_POLL_REF_BIAS` to `(unsigned int)atomic_read(&req->poll_refs) >= IO_POLL_REF_BIAS`, explicitly stating that `atomic_read()` returns a signed int and that the cancel flag (BIT(31)) makes the value negative, causing the comparison to always evaluate to false.
